issues.description: Ingest only upserts current records and never removes rows from prior ingests, so reports can include stale results after input files are deleted or changed.
Malformed XML raises ElementTree.ParseError and crashes ingest instead of producing a structured malformed_row warning.
Format B assumes metrics is a dict; a string/list metrics value raises AttributeError instead of being treated as malformed or missing_score.
NaN scores are accepted as floats, bypass clamping, and later crash SQLite insertion with a NOT NULL constraint failure.
Format A reads the entire CSV file into memory, which is fragile for large evaluation exports.
Format B reads the entire JSONL file into memory instead of streaming line by line.
Format A parses CSV one physical line at a time, so valid quoted fields containing newlines are misparsed.
The report omits sources with zero persisted rows, which can hide missing or failed source ingestion.
The empty-input error path calls ingest first, creating or migrating the database despite returning failure.
Pipeline tests cover generated fixtures but miss malformed object shapes, malformed XML, non-finite scores, and stale-row reingest behavior.
Project metadata has no test/dev optional dependency for pytest, so a fresh contributor cannot discover test requirements from package metadata.
